name: aglit-plugin
description: Set up and connect to your supported computers through Aglit.

interface.longDescription: Set up and connect to your supported computers through Aglit. Enroll an Apple silicon Mac or Windows x64 PC, find registered computers, open Aglit Console, and troubleshoot access. This plugin provides agent instructions for the Aglit CLI; it does not install the CLI automatically or create an MCP connection. Requires local desktop execution, an Aglit account, and a compatible Desktop runtime on each target. First-time sign-in and OS permissions require user participation. Private SSH is conditional on compatible macOS runtime support and is not advertised as generally available.
defaultPrompt: Help me connect to my Office Mac through Aglit.
Set up my Windows PC for remote access through Aglit.
